title: SEC2: upload handler buffers full body in memory
description: blob_upload_handler accumulates the full request body (up to 100 MiB) via to_bytes before writing to disk and hashing. Peak heap use equals blob size. Fix: stream request body through an incremental Sha256 hasher while writing chunks to the tmp file, so peak memory is one chunk not the full blob. Needs a streaming write variant in BlobStore.
